title: Baghdad
sideASummary: Player deck back. No printed text.
sideBSummary: Baghdad, 33°18'46"N 44°21'41"E, code P2-04b. Regional map with a bullseye in the center. Compass has no anchor. No search box. The city name and coordinates repeat upside down along the bottom.

rules: Second black Player card for Baghdad. Not a port. No search.

notes: The recon report puts this card on the Player discard pile with P2-03b.
